Results.ReviewText: Arrived damaged.  First part I needed for assembly was bent in two places.  Called customer service and they sent a replacement.  When part arrived I continued assembly.  Part way through I found another part that was bent.  It wasn't as bad as the first.  Within 20 minutes I was able to bend it back so it was usable.  Continued assembly again only to find the lid to the grill was also damaged.  It doesn't show much until you lift the lid.  Then you can see where it is bent and the missing and flaking paint around the bend.  Decided to live with it instead of going through the hassle of waiting for another part to ship and arrive.  The grill itself?  I don't know, haven't had time to use it yet.
Results.Title: Arrived Damaged - Several bent parts

Results.ReviewText: We're retired and do not have any relationship with Weber but glad to review our grill for others. That said, our new Weber Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill looks good, has a reasonably small footprint, starts quickly, works great, and is simple to clean. The cover too, is handsome, high quality, and easy to take off and put on against weather. We have only good things to say about our "Made in USA" Weber grill. One small drawback was putting it together but the directions are easy to follow and it kept me out of trouble for a few hours. Thanks Weber, for keeping it American quality at a good price.
Results.Title: Made in USA Weber quality!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
